title: Circuit evaluation from its encoding
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit with $m$ input vertices, with distinct arguments at each gate, exactly one argument at every NOT gate, and at most two arguments at every gate. For every bit string $x$ of length $m$, the circuit evaluator applied to the encoding of $C$ paired with $x$ returns the same Boolean value as evaluating $C$ on the input assignment that gives input $i$ the bit at position $i$ of $x$ (using $0$ when that position is absent).
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit with m inputs
C is well formed: each gate's argument list has no duplicates and each NOT gate has exactly one argument
every gate has at most two arguments
